title: Aircrew of Wellington R1801
memorial_details: description: AT 16:05 HOURS ON 7TH OCTOBER 1942, AND RAF WELLINGTON BOMBER PASSED/LOW OVER THIS PLACE.  ON A ROUTINE TRAINING FLIGHT, IT RAN INTO DIFFICULTY/ SOON AFTER TAKE OFF FROM RAF WYMESWOLD./ AS THE CREW FOUGHT TO KEEP THE AIRCRAFT IN THE AIR IT WAS SEEN PASSING/ LOWOVER THE ROOF OF BEAUMANOR HALL, JETTISONING FUEL AS IT WENT./ EYWITNESSES SAW IT CLIPA TREETOP AND NARROWLY MISS THE STEEPLE/ OF ST MARY IN THE ELMS CHURCH BEFORE COMING DOWN NEARBY./ WORKMEN FROM BEAUMANOR, PASSENGERS FROM A PASSING BUS AND VILLAGERS RAN TO GIVE ASSISTENCE, BUT THE AIRCRAFT WAS SOON ENGULFED IN/ FLAMES AND EXPLODING MUNITIONS.  THE VALIENT CREW OF THREE WERE ALL LOST./(names)/ IN GREATFUL REMEMBRANCE FROM LOCAL PEOPLE;/ WENT THE DAY WELL?/ WE DIED AND NEVER KNEW,/ BUT, WELL OR ILL, FREEDOM, WE DIED FOR YOU
